name: Person
definition: Human entity, as distinguished from a corporate entity (which is sometimes referred to as an 'artificial person').

Gender.name: Gender
Gender.definition: Specifies the gender of the person.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: Language in which a person communicates.

BirthDate.name: Birth Date
BirthDate.definition: Date on which a person is born.

Profession.name: Profession
Profession.definition: Name of the occupation or job of a person.

ResidentialStatus.name: Residential Status
ResidentialStatus.definition: Residential status of an individual, for example, non-permanent resident.

MinorIndicator.name: Minor Indicator
MinorIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the person is a legal minor. It may depend on the nationality, the domicile country or the transaction in which the person is involved.

BusinessFunctionTitle.name: Business Function Title
BusinessFunctionTitle.definition: Title of the function in an organisation.

CivilStatus.name: Civil Status
CivilStatus.definition: Specifies the civil status of a person.

DeathDate.name: Death Date
DeathDate.definition: Date on which a person is dead.

CitizenshipEndDate.name: Citizenship End Date
CitizenshipEndDate.definition: Date of the end of citizenship.

CitizenshipStartDate.name: Citizenship Start Date
CitizenshipStartDate.definition: Date of the commencement of citizenship.

PlaceOfBirth.name: Place Of Birth
PlaceOfBirth.definition: Place (for instance Country and City) where a person was born.

Nationality.name: Nationality
Nationality.definition: Specifies the country where a person was born or is legally accepted as belonging to the country.

PersonIdentification.name: Person Identification
PersonIdentification.definition: Specific identification assigned to a person. It is derived from the association between Party and PartyIdentification.

EmployingParty.name: Employing Party
EmployingParty.definition: Party which is the employer of a person.

MeetingAttendee.name: Meeting Attendee
MeetingAttendee.definition: Specifies the meeting attendee which is an individual person.

RelatedRole.name: Related Role
RelatedRole.definition: Role performed by the person for the proxy voting process.

PreAssignedProxyPerson.name: Pre Assigned Proxy Person
PreAssignedProxyPerson.definition: Specifies the person who is the pre-assigned proxy for a meeting.

PersonProfile.name: Person Profile
PersonProfile.definition: Information to support the Know Your Customer processes.

ContactPersonRole.name: Contact Person Role
ContactPersonRole.definition: Contact role played by a person.

Household.name: Household
Household.definition: Specifies the members of a household in relation with the ownership of an account.

DrivingLicense.name: Driving License
DrivingLicense.definition: Drving license granted to the person.
